scope: Known backend runtime, compatibility, mixed-legacy and retired-product boundaries. Classification is by responsibility/surface; a LEGACY module is a Stage 11 migration target, not permission to delete it.
rules: Do not delete a compatibility path until its HTTP/Python callers are proven migrated.
Do not delete the canonical Door Cutting Order DocType base class; Frappe requires the active override to subclass it.

Stage 11 must split mixed modules before deleting historical endpoints.
DEAD requires positive evidence of zero hook, HTTP, Python-import and test consumers; none met that bar in this audit.
